name: Rangeley Waterfront Retreat
listingFacts:
Verified from Airbnb listing 1615903668655366123 on 2026-10-19 (America/Los_Angeles).
Listing title: Spacious 4BR Retreat | Walk to Town | Close to Ski.
Entire multi-level condo in Rangeley, Maine. Hosts: Michelle & Darryl. Up to 10 guests; 4 bedrooms; 2.5 bathrooms. Header reports 8 beds; use explicit sleeping descriptions instead of inventing a derived total.
Second floor: king bedroom with adjoining bunk room. Third floor: queen bedroom and oversized bunk room. First-floor lounge has a queen pull-out sofa. The listing narrative and bedroom-card captions differ on the precise futon placement; do not assert a futon's room until resolved.
Open living, dining and equipped kitchen; wood-burning fireplace; books and games. Private main deck with wooded views and glimpses of Rangeley Lake. The primary bedroom has a small adults-only deck.
Basement play space: ping-pong table, dry bar and indoor basketball hoop. Separate sitting nook for reading.
About half a mile from downtown Rangeley. Listing estimates Saddleback at a 15-minute drive and Sugarloaf at about 40 minutes; these are host estimates, not verified route guarantees. Snowmobile trails connect from the driveway. No resort-ranking claim should be reused without checking its primary source.
Guests have the whole condo and 40 feet of SHARED lake access with swimming area and canoe/kayak storage. A short downhill walk over a natural, uneven path leads to the shared waterfront. No private beach or private dock claim.
Shared dock for canoe/kayak launching and temporary motorboat loading/unloading only. Boats may not be tied up, moored or left there. Rangeley Town Park Boat Launch is listed as less than 1 mile away.
On-property parking with trailer space. Wood shed stocked for fireplace or outdoor fire pit.
Check-in after 4:00 PM; checkout before 11:00 AM; 10 guests maximum. Keypad self check-in. Exterior doorbell camera. No pet permission, nightly price or cancellation policy inferred.
14 supplied genuine reviews, each rated 5 stars. Retain Lynn's date as “1 week ago”; do not invent a precise review date. Reviewer account tenure is not their location.
